Bunia: Language Survey Department, SIL Eastern Zaire Group. (SIL Language & Culture Archives entry 32358; re-issued 2021.)
sources.note: Nothing. Rapid-appraisal sociolinguistic survey. p. 6: Lombi and Meegye/Mangbetu 'have clearly similar phonologies and lexicon', Lombi has a voiceless w; Appendices 3-5 (pp. 23-35) give tone-marked lexical and grammatical data and a glossed text ('Unmarked tones assumed low'; 1st/2nd person sg/pl 'distinguished by tone in Medje and Gombari; probably also true in Lombi'). No remark on stress or accent anywhere (scanned grepped and relevant pages read).
